manifestations.description: decreased movement of the ring and little fingers
deformities with limitation of motion of his right fingers
still feeling pain on the right from time to time
V-shaped operation scar at the palm centre and Z-shaped operation scar from the proximal part of the palm to the right wrist

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: After the accident, he can no longer enjoy swimming and playing ping pong games.
There was a V-shaped operation scar at the palm centre and a Z-shaped operation scar from the proximal part of the palm to the right wrist. 1% of whole person impairment allocated for the scars.
He will be unlikely to get back to his previous trade as a mechanic and his present hand is a definite handicap in finding a new job.

comparable_cases.case_name: Leung Lai Yin v Yeung Kei Chi (t.a Shum Hing Furniture Decorating Construction & ors.)
comparable_cases.injury_description: Plaintiff's left hand was cut by a circular saw. He suffered near amputation of his left index and ring fingers while his middle finger was amputated. But he was able to return to his original occupation as a carpenter.

comparable_cases.case_name: Tsang Chung Wan v Li Ming or Lee Ming & ors.
comparable_cases.injury_description: Injuries to the middle and ring fingers of the right hand as a result of the fingers being crushed between the steel bar and the rotating axis of the steel bar bending machine. Comminuted fracture of the proximal phalanx of his right ring finger. Operated with K-wire fixation and skin grafting performed on his middle finger.

comparable_cases.case_name: Lo Chi Bun v Leung Wah Kwan
comparable_cases.injury_description: Injured his right hand by an electric saw with fracture of the metacarpal bones, a 4 cm transverse laceration over the dorsum of the right hand and a 3 cm longitudinal laceration of the right ring finger. Dominant hand became stiff and weak.
